name: Joachim Stanisław Brudziński - Proposition de décision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section X – European External Action Service
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European External Action Service spent its 2023 budget, which paid for its Brussels headquarters and 144 delegations worldwide. It also asks for more money for foreign policy, security and fighting disinformation, and warns that budget cuts have delayed building repairs and security work. It calls for better gender balance, action against harassment, and more transparency about lobbying and spending.

- Parliament formally approves the service's 2023 spending; no money changes hands now.
- The service and its staff worldwide are affected, including delegations facing security and repair delays.
- Next, the service must act on Parliament's requests, such as joining the transparency register.
